name: Declare embedding support in a PHP AI Client 1.4 provider
query: I am updating a WordPress AI provider plugin for wordpress/php-ai-client 1.4. What must its provider and model metadata implement so embeddings with configurable dimensions resolve correctly, and how are capabilities different from options?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route provider-level work to wp-ai-connectors and confirm the standalone or Core-bundled SDK version before using 1.4-only APIs
Step 2: Use the all-static ProviderInterface contract and prefer AbstractProvider or ApiBasedImplementation/AbstractApiProvider rather than inventing instance registration methods
Step 3: Keep generation kinds in CapabilityEnum and declare embedding_generation with CapabilityEnum::embeddingGeneration()
Step 4: Keep configuration knobs in SupportedOption values keyed by OptionEnum; do not invent json_response, system_instruction, function_calling, or streaming CapabilityEnum cases
Step 5: Declare OptionEnum::dimensions() when the embedding model accepts caller-selected vector dimensions
Step 6: Return a model implementing EmbeddingGenerationModelInterface::generateEmbeddingResult(array $inputs): EmbeddingResult
Step 7: Preserve one output embedding per input and input order, because EmbeddingBuilder validates the count
Step 8: Smoke-test model metadata resolution through AiClient::input(...)->usingDimensions(...)->isSupported() and generation
success_criteria: Names the exact ProviderInterface static methods or the matching AbstractProvider create methods
Separates CapabilityEnum generation/history values from OptionEnum configuration values
Uses embeddingGeneration and dimensions with their exact verified names
Names EmbeddingGenerationModelInterface and its generateEmbeddingResult signature
Does not invent SDK enum cases or treat input/output modalities as generation capabilities
Version-gates embedding provider guidance to PHP AI Client 1.4 or a Core version that bundles it
